text:
Carmen: quick flag  users reporting brief duplicate session rows in console on reconnects after yesterday's routing tweak.
Diego: saw the spike on the dashboard. SSE heavy?
Carmen: yes, SSE mostly; a couple WS multiplexed flows too. repro with harness: client soft-close -> immediate reconnect -> new route claim before old session tombstone cleared.
Priya: paste the small log sample?
Carmen: ```
[proxy] 2026-04-20T07:11:10.000 route-claim client=c-99 ttl=60ms shard=eu1
[proxy] 2026-04-20T07:11:10.120 client-close c-99 code=1000
[client] 2026-04-20T07:11:10.150 reconnect c-99 new-shard=eu2
[billing] 2026-04-20T07:11:10.160 charge-start session=c-99
[billing] 2026-04-20T07:11:10.430 charge-start session=c-99.b
```
Diego: billing triggers on route claim, so overlapping claims -> overlapping charges.
Priya: short-term mitigations: revert the TTL tweak on canary, or add console UI to hide overlaps <500ms and annotate as "probable route-swap".
Carmen: long-term: billing idempotency window (1s) keyed by Last-Event-ID when present, else a client fingerprint. Also telemetry: histogram of overlap durations and top-k fingerprints.
billing-bot: noted: billing team will prototype idempotent-charge heuristic in staging.
ops-bot: canary rollback recommended; sampling of affected traces enabled.
Diego: agree revert on canary now, add metric and small console annotation to reduce support noise while infra lands the billing change.
Priya: also ping sdks@ to encourage consistent Last-Event-ID on SSE reconnects; that makes dedupe exact.
Carmen: filing INFRA-2410 revert-canary, BILL-430 idempotent-charge-rfc, METR-912 overlap-metrics. Thanks all.
